title: Performance Optimization
description: Learn techniques to optimize Redux performance in large applications.

data.text: Redux performance issues often stem from unnecessary re-renders. Use selectors and memoization to keep your app fast.

data.title: createSelector

items: Avoid inline object creation in selectors

data.title: Reselect
data.text: createSelector memoizes results. It only recomputes when inputs change, preventing unnecessary re-renders.
